flags.name: FLOUR TORTILLAS 12X28GM 6INCH Simson's Pantry
flags.issue: Costed 24x too dear. Feed says $5.00/ea (pack_qty 12, needs_pack_review FALSE). Invoice SI4423598 line reads qty=1, raw_uom='CTN-24', $60.00, description '12X28GM' = 12 tortillas of 28gm per pack. The UOM states the carton holds 24 packs, so $60.00 buys 24 x 12 = 288 tortillas = $0.2083 each. The pack derivation used the 12 from the description and ignored the -24 in the UOM. Confirmed from the invoice's own raw_uom field, not inferred.
flags.suggested_fix: Apply the CTN-N carton multiplier when the pack resolves to a COUNT. pack_qty for 101115 should be 288 ea ($0.2083/ea), not 12. NOTE the multiplier IS already being applied when the pack resolves to a weight/volume - Foodlink 100175 (CTN-6) is 18000g and 100487 Camembert (CTN-12) is $30.40/kg, both correct - so the defect is specific to the 'ea' branch.

flags.name: CHIPS 10MM CRISPY COATED 4X.2.5KG Farm Frites
flags.issue: Costed 4x too dear. Feed says $0.022/g = $22.00/kg (pack_qty 2500g, needs_pack_review FALSE). Invoice SI4429436 reads qty=1, raw_uom='CTN', $55.00, description 'CHIPS 10MM CRISPY COATED 4X.2.5KG' = 4 bags of 2.5kg = 10kg per carton, so the true cost is $5.50/kg. $22/kg for frozen coated chips is also implausible on its face. The pack parser read the '2.5KG' and dropped the '4X' multiplier - it handles '96X15GM' correctly on the same invoice (samosas -> 1440g), so the failure is the stray dot in '4X.2.5KG'. This is the only Foodlink line in 4 months of invoices using that form. Confirmed from the description and UOM on the invoice, not inferred.
flags.suggested_fix: pack_qty 10000g ($0.0055/g = $5.50/kg). Root fix: let the multiplier regex tolerate a separator between the X and the number, i.e. accept (\d+)\s*[xX]\s*[.\s]?\s*([\d.]+)\s*(KG|GM|G|LT|ML) as well as the digit-adjacent form.

flags.name: WPM Tonkotsu Straight #24 10/5p Frozen Straight Ramen 130g
flags.issue: Costed ~5x too dear. Feed says $0.036154/g = $36.15/kg (pack_qty 130g, needs_pack_review FALSE), from invoice 001828752 qty=1 EACH at $4.70. The invoiced EACH is a 5-PORTION BAG, not one 130g portion. Confirmed by its sibling on the SAME invoice: jfc:56296 'WPM Yellow Ramen #22 12/5pc Frozen Straight Noodle 125gx5' also invoices at EACH ($4.20) and was parsed as pack_qty 5 at $0.84 per portion, because its description spells the multiplier out as '125gx5'. 56727 writes the same fact as '10/5p' (10 bags per carton, 5 portions per bag) and the '5p' was not read. True figure: $4.70 / (5 x 130g) = $0.00723/g = $7.23/kg, i.e. $0.94 per portion - which matches 56296's $6.72/kg. Confirmed against the sibling's own parse, not guessed.
flags.suggested_fix: pack_qty 650g ($0.00723/g). Root fix: read JFC's 'N/Mp' pack notation (e.g. '10/5p', '12/5pc') the same way '125gx5' is already read - the LAST factor is portions per selling unit.

flags.name: Limes (LIM)
flags.issue: Pack unit is a bare 'tray' with pack_qty 1 and needs_pack_review FALSE, so nothing else will surface it. Invoice 3122236 (2026-08-19) reads 'LIMES TRAY', qty=1 TRAY, $78.00. A recipe or cocktail spec that adds one lime off this picker entry books $78.00. Limes are a daily-use bar ingredient, so this is the highest-exposure entry in today's batch. The tray count and the tray weight are BOTH absent from the invoice - it states only 'TRAY'.
flags.suggested_fix: NOT GUESSED - the count is not on the invoice and was not inferred. Needs Zak or Select Fresh to confirm limes (or kg) per tray, then a pack_override on 'select-fresh:LIM'. A cross-check exists once the weight is known: the same supplier already has a per-kg 'Limes' row at $0.014/g = $14.00/kg, so a tray weight near 5.5kg would reconcile the two. Also worth noting the picker now shows four lime rows including a second tray (Lightspeed 'Lime' at $30.00/tray) - whichever is stale should be retired so the chef is not choosing between them.

flags.name: SAMOSAS COCKTAIL 96X15GM Pacific West

Costed per gram (pack_qty 1440g, $0.00972/g), while foodlink:102675 'SPRING ROLL COCKTAIL 15gm 96'S Pacific West' - same supplier, same brand, same $14.00, same 96 x 15gm pack, on the SAME invoice SI4429436 - is costed per each (96 ea, $0.1458). A chef adding six samosas has to key 90g for one product and 6 for the other.
